mechanics.claim: Destiny has no damage of its own; it reveals enemies and Gate blinks TF and destroys incoming projectiles, with no on-hit or damage effect.
mechanics.quote: '''Twisted Fate''' marks all targetable enemy champions, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for a duration.

mechanics.claim: Both the initial cast and the Gate recast count as separate ability activations, which can trigger on-cast item/passive effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown does not start on cast; it starts only after the recast is used or the recast window times out.
mechanics.quote: Starts after recast times out or is used

mechanics.claim: While channeling Gate, Pick a Card can still be cast but Wild Cards is disabled.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Pick a Card|Twisted Fate}} is usable. {{ai|Wild Cards|Twisted Fate}} is disabled.
